External withdraw entry: applies interest, computes adjusted amount, debits storage then transfers tokens.
External borrow entry: applies interest, credits borrow amount then transfers tokens to caller.
External repay entry: applies interest, caps amount by borrow balance and pulls tokens via _transferFrom.
External reserve deposit: increases reserved/total deposit and pulls tokens from caller.
Only-owner reserve withdrawal: decreases reserved/total and transfers to reserved address.

Market-manager-only reward payout transferring collateral to liquidator.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to userAddr inside deposit and becomes the credited depositor.
msg.sender is assigned to userAddr inside withdraw and becomes the debited/paid account.
msg.sender is assigned to userAddr inside borrow and receives the transferred tokens.
msg.sender is assigned to userAddr inside repay and supplies the tokens.
msg.sender is passed to _transferFrom in reserveDeposit without further validation.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner to gate the circuit-breaker setter.
onlyMarketManager modifier compares msg.sender to marketManager or owner.
onlyOwner modifier authorizes ownership transfer based on msg.sender.
onlyMarketManager modifier gates liquidation entry based on msg.sender.
onlyMarketManager modifier gates reward payout entry based on msg.sender.
deposit writes deposit amounts through handlerDataStorage.
withdraw reads limitOfAction and debits user deposit via handlerDataStorage.
deposit calls marketManager.applyInterestHandlers or rewardUpdateOfInAction.
_transfer uses erc20Instance to move the underlying token.
_transferFrom uses erc20Instance to pull the underlying token.
_applyInterest routes through interestModelInstance to compute interest deltas.
deposit invokes marketManager.applyInterestHandlers before crediting the user.
deposit pulls depositor tokens through _transferFrom.
_transferFrom performs the external erc20Instance.transferFrom call.
withdraw calls _transfer to pay out the adjusted amount.
borrow calls _transfer to pay out to the borrower.
repay calls _transferFrom to collect tokens from the repayer.
partialLiquidationUserReward calls _transfer to pay the liquidator.
reserveWithdraw calls _transfer to the reserved address.
reserveDeposit calls _transferFrom from msg.sender.
_transfer performs the external erc20Instance.transfer to a caller-supplied user address.
A malicious token can re-enter withdraw during the external transfer before accounting is finalized.
A malicious token can re-enter borrow during the external transfer to the borrower.
A malicious token can re-enter the liquidation reward payout during the transfer to the liquidator.
_applyInterest triggers interestModelInstance.getInterestAmount external call.
_applyInterest calls _checkFirstAction for per-block bookkeeping.
_applyInterest reaches _updateReservedAmount through _setAmountReflectInterest.
checkFirstAction is the external wrapper around _checkFirstAction.
partialLiquidationUser calls marketManager.getMaxLiquidationReward to size the liquidation.
partialLiquidationUser computes unifiedDiv(delinquentBorrowAsset, delinquentDepositAsset) which reverts or divides by zero if collateral is zero.
_transfer converts the unified amount to underlying decimals.
_transferFrom converts the unified amount to underlying decimals.
_convertUnifiedToUnderlying divides by unifiedTokenDecimal which is owner-settable and may be zero.
_getTokenLiquidityLimitAmount scales deposit totals via unifiedMul.
withdraw debits user deposit through handlerDataStorage.subDepositAmount external call.
borrow credits user borrow through handlerDataStorage.addBorrowAmount external call.
userAddr parameter flows into _transfer as the ERC20 recipient.
unifiedTokenAmount parameter flows into _convertUnifiedToUnderlying.
newOwner parameter is written directly to the owner state variable without validation.
liquidator parameter is the recipient inside partialLiquidationUserReward.
delinquentBorrower parameter drives the liquidation accounting in partialLiquidationUser.
reserveAddr local variable is the recipient of the reserve withdrawal transfer.
adjustedAmount local variable is the value passed to _transfer inside withdraw.

normalization_plan.reason: userAddr is only a formal boundary for the untrusted caller address; its semantic role is the recipient of the internal ERC20 transfer.
unifiedTokenAmount has no independent semantics beyond being scaled by the conversion routine before transfer.
newOwner is consumed directly by the ownership assignment and requires no separate abstraction.
liquidator is only the payout recipient within the liquidation reward function.
delinquentBorrower is a purely local argument of the liquidation accounting routine.
reserveAddr is a transient handle read from storage used only as the transfer destination.
adjustedAmount is a transient computed value immediately forwarded to _transfer in withdraw.
